file_format.md.131: - `rank` is optional and lives on the ticket, preventing a shared board-order file from becoming a conflict hotspot. It affects order only when the board's device-local sort option is **Manual**. Drag-and-drop is disabled for priority sorting and writes ranks only in Manual mode. In v0, LongClaw owns rank allocation; agents preserve existing ranks and do not invent them.
file_format.md.194: - Activity is sorted by `occurred_at`, with `id` used as a deterministic tie-breaker.
file_format.md.231: Tickets store label slugs. This lets a label's display name or color change without rewriting every ticket carrying that label.
file_format.md.345: - `status: canceled` records a workflow outcome and keeps the ticket active in history and search.
file_format.md.347: - Hard deletion is not part of the normal ticket workflow. If added, it should use a recoverable trash operation and must never reuse the deleted ticket key.
